Chapter 6774: Pardon Order

Chapter 6774: Pardon Order

“Lord of the Stars.” The overlord said.

“Lord of the Stars, that’s a good title, the lord of this world too.” Li Qiye said with a smile.

“Immortal, please don’t misunderstand, I am only staying here and do not impose my will on Beastmaster. It is entirely independent.” The overlord shook his head.

“Avoiding all responsibilities now, I see.” Li Qiye clapped.

“Immortal, this is the truth.” The overlord said with a bitter expression: “I spent my time cultivating in Ancient World and rarely left. I only resided here occasionally and never ruled, my ties with this world are shallow.”

He was right that, given his lifespan, the time he spent here was relatively insignificant. Emperors and ancestors changed continuously during this period.

He cursed Sky Zenith and Yudi for being idiots. Out of everyone, they chose to antagonize such powerful immortals beyond the supreme or golden stage. Otherwise, his grandmaster would have dealt with it easily.

In this case, this primordial immortal was only a maid. He couldn’t possibly imagine the master. Could he possibly be a shored immortal?

Such a character wouldn’t need to give a damn about his grandmaster.

“I see.” Li Qiye stroked his chin.

“Yes, Great Immortal, there is not much karma between us.” The overlord wanted to wipe the slate clean.

In fact, he had the urge to destroy Sky Zenith for dragging him into this fatal mess.

Zenith Sky had no idea that their backer wanted to destroy them. Sure, the presence of immortals was disastrous for any world. This applied to overlords as well.

“I wonder if I should let you go.” Li Qiye said.

“Yes, please, Great Immortal, I also have a pardon order.” The overlord saw hope.

“A pardon order?” Li Qiye asked.

“I redeemed it from Duality Enterprise.” He said.

“Duality Enterprise?” Li Qiye gestured at Xiaoyue.

She released the suppression. After all, it was rather unnecessary since he posed no threat to Li Qiye.

“Please take a look, Great Immortal, this is my pardon order.” He took out a crystal badge, clearly made from rare and precious temporal crystals in Heavenrealm.

Li Qiye took it and saw the character “pardon” engraved on it with a rather interesting calligraphic style, more freestyle than anything.

“How did you get it?” Li Qiye asked.

“Great Immortal, I have performed services for Duality Enterprise. This order allows me to be spared from death in Heavenrealm.” He elaborated.

“Is that so? This enterprise is really flexing its influence.” Li Qiye smiled.

This startled him since he didn’t know whether this order would be effective against this immortal.

Those on this level could be counted with one’s fingers in Heavenrealm. Although he didn’t know which one was Li Qiye, he didn’t dare to ask.

Normally, immortals always gave face to Duality Enterprise. This might not be the case to his misfortune.

“Great Immortal, this is Duality Enterprise’s promise based on its reputation. I do not dare to comment on it.” He said.

Duality was one of the two greatest enterprises in Heavenrealm. It appeared relatively recent in the grand scheme of things. However, its rise to prominence was miraculous.

The founder of Duality Enterprise had ties with all the immortals in Heavenrealm, whether it be the most common type or primordial immortals. This was why the enterprise dared to have these pardon orders.

“Buzz.” As Li Qiye activated the order, a bald figure appeared within the crystal.

The baldy smiled radiantly, possessing an unparalleled sense of amicability. Anyone would feel close to him at first sight.

“Brothers and sisters, I beg your benevolence if you are somehow offended. Let me know if I can be of service...” The baldy bowed in all directions, displaying politeness and charm.

Li Qiye couldn’t help but smile. However, this was not just a lifeless projection. It was connected to the founder, allowing real-time communication.

“Old man...” The baldy was surprised to see him.

“Doing some business?” Li Qiye smiled.

“What’s it to you?” The baldy muttered irritably.

“Seems like I’m the other party.” Li Qiye said.

“Yeah, yeah.” He looked annoyed and suddenly, the crystal order shattered.

“Master, I’m not pardoned yet!” The Lord of the Stars anxiously shouted. The founder clearly knew Li Qiye so this was his chance.
